craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of sealing — utsāha as measure, course, denial, seal land in turn. Course told: intellects resting on Māyā-knowers drive transaction — the world’s business given its drivers. Rejected: (a) Māyā-knowers→the deluded → killed: resting (āśrita) is precise, not delusion (v22 denies that next). (b) transaction→business → killed: vyavahāra load term. Read aloud: SO re-LA-tion's-COURSE is-TOLD: in-tel-LECTS … DRIV-ing TRANS-ac-TION.

lines: So relation's course is told: intellects
resting on Māyā-knowers, of varied views, driving transaction.
l4.sanskrit_cite: iti saṃbandhagatyuktā māyīyajñātṛniṣṭhitāḥ dhiyo vibhinnārthadṛśo vyavahārapravartikāḥ

reads_against.argmap: What course is told? → Course told: Māyā-knower-resting intellects drive transaction.
c1_essence: Secondaries measured against chiefs — king's man, brahmin's; other chiefs, other unities — king's horse, man (vv19-20).
Course told, delusion denied, seal spoken: Māyā-knower-resting intellects drive transaction, moment-grounded in self-awareness; told, proved, unrefuted, useful, full apparatus besides (vv21-23).
